column1: # Vacated rule numbers. A vacated number is never reused, and nothing
# cites it: scripts/ci/check_vacated_rule_numbers.py fails on any citation
# of one, and scripts/rules/sweep_rule_citations.py rewrites citations to
# the successor named here. Ruled 2026-11-19 (Round 0 §7) and 2026-11-27.
# Columns (tab-separated): number, old name, status, repository, successor.
# status renumbered: successor is the rule's new file stem in that repository.
# status retired: successor is the record that keeps the rule's text.
